clips.title: The story
paras: Twisted trees and hungry beasts crowd Nightmare Vale in southwestern Tirisfal Glades, west of the Crusader's Outpost. Once a forest haven, it now lies blighted and withered.

Before the Third War, songbirds and woodland game filled this valley in the Tirisfal countryside. After the Scourge's plague, its plants blackened and rotted. Ravenous darkhounds and massive vampire bats consumed the native wildlife, leaving the hollow to scavengers and beasts of prey.

Ressan the Needler, an unusually large, pale vampire bat, lurks in Nightmare Vale and is known to local travelers. The vale lies between haunted wilderness and the zealous sentries at the nearby Crusader's Outpost. Unwary travelers crossing this unforgiving expanse can quickly become prey.
